blockers: C1.8.4 — UAT-REC-C1-03 forced-gap positive test is `#[ignore]`-marked and BLOCKED on a `chronos_log::segmented` bookkeeping bug: any path that inserts a `Gap` entry into a `SegmentedExecutionLog` (both the `record_gap` direct API and the memory-budget overflow path) produces a segment header that mis-counts ('segment declares N records but holds N-1' on reopen). The negative test (`complete` for clean session) passes; the positive test (`gap_detected` for forced-gap) is gated on the fix, which is out of scope for REC-C1 and belongs in a separate m1-* follow-up cycle. See `chronos-sandbox/tests/rec_c1_8_uat_c1_03_forced_gap.rs` file-level doc-comment.

notes:
REC-C1.8 closes the three REC-C1 acceptance discrepancies left open by C1.7. (1) Documental drift: ROADMAP_CONTROL_PLANE.md 9ee74f09 -> 6190390d; active_gate REC-C1.8 -> REC-C2. (2) dual_truth RED tests: dual_truth_characterization.rs deleted; replaced by chronos-sandbox/tests/rec_c1_8_dual_truth_closeout.rs (3 black-box wire tests: wrapper rebuilds engine from log on empty map; late-append rebuild on a fresh process; state_query gate does not return SessionNotFound for a log-only session). (3) UATs: UAT-REC-C1-01 exact literal 10k records + producer advance + A resumes (rec_c1_8_uat_c1_01_exact); UAT-REC-C1-03 negative `complete` arm green on the wire, positive forced-gap arm blocked on FIND-C1.8-01 (segmented-log gap bookkeeping bug, deferred to m1-*); UAT-REC-C1-05 four-dim independence with the new captured_at_unix_ns dimension on ExecutionRecord + NewExecutionRecord (rec_c1_8_uat_c1_05_four_dim).

FIND-C1.8-01 (real bug, real reproducer, deferred, NOT fixed here): chronos_log::segmented segment-header bookkeeping mis-counts gap entries. Any path that inserts a Gap into a SegmentedExecutionLog (record_gap direct API, or memory-budget overflow) produces a segment header that declares N records while the on-disk file holds N-1, so the segment is rejected on reopen with a 'replay integrity failure'. Reproducer: chronos-sandbox/tests/rec_c1_8_uat_c1_03_forced_gap.rs::uat_rec_c1_03_forced_gap_reports_gap_detected (#[ignore]-marked). Belongs in a separate m1-* follow-up cycle; out of scope for REC-C1.

Closure conventions match rec-c1-5/6/7: archive_status=ready (no .sddk-knowledge/changes/archive/rec-c1-8-*/ directory); single-branch cycle; annotated tag `rec-c1-8-authoritative-evidence-handoff`. REC-C1 acceptance is CLOSED; REC-C2 (legacy deletion) is the active product gate.
